title: BUGFIX — /gate shows URL-missing warning when views stuck at 0 (16 posts with no tiktok_url)
rationale: Gate shows views=0/500 with no action hint. All 16 posts have no tiktok_url — views can't be tracked. The operator checks /gate often but gets no hint about the root cause. Fix: in cmdGate(), when totalViews===0 AND posts exist without tiktok_url, append a prominent warning with the count of URL-missing posts and a /pending-urls shortcut. This surfaces the action item in the most frequently-checked command.

tasks.description: In scripts/telegram-commands/cmd-gate.ts cmdGate(): after the views line, add a sprint-1376 inline block: if totalViews === 0 and realPosts.length > 0, count posts without tiktok_url; if any, push a warning line: '⚠️ _[N] posts have no URL — run /pending-urls to add them (views can't track without URL)_'.
